summary: AutoVault MVP end-to-end testing completed. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed covering auth (login/register/me/logout, invalid creds, dup email, unauth), vehicles CRUD with ownership scoping, maintenance/fuel/expenses CRUD with vehicle ownership validation, and dashboard stats schema. Frontend smoke test verified login with prefilled demo creds, dashboard with 3 seeded vehicles + stats, garage with 3 vehicle cards, maintenance/fuel/expenses/profile pages all load without page errors, and Sign out clears session and redirects to /login.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <option> in vehicle filter <select> at CrudListPage.jsx line 70. Looks like the dynamic expression for v.brand/v.model is wrapped in a span which is invalid HTML inside <option>. Render plain text instead.

Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. ResponsiveContainer parent has zero size on initial render. Add explicit minHeight or aspect prop, or ensure parent has a defined height.

action_items: Fix invalid HTML in CrudListPage.jsx line ~70: don't wrap dynamic text in <span> inside <option>; render `{v.brand} {v.model}` directly so React doesn't warn about hydration.
Give Recharts ResponsiveContainer an explicit height (e.g., height={260}) or wrap in a sized parent on Fuel/Expenses cards to silence width/height(-1) warning and ensure charts render.
(Optional, prod) CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; set explicit origin(s) before production. Works in current preview environment.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (FastAPI lifespan is preferred).
JWT_SECRET is read from env without a graceful failure path; missing env crashes only on first token op. Consider failing fast on startup.
Cookie set with secure=True and samesite=none requires HTTPS – fine on preview URL, but local http dev will silently drop cookies.
_crud_routes closure works but uses the same `model` symbol for Pydantic body and route var name pattern; fine but slightly hard to extend (e.g., partial updates require new model).
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (test_credentials playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Add throttling if required by playbook.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, dashboard, garage, maintenance, fuel, expenses, profile, signout)

test_credentials: demo@autovault.app / demo12345 (verified working); admin@autovault.app / admin12345 (seeded, not exercised in UI)
seed_data_creation: Seeded by backend on startup: demo user + 3 vehicles + maintenance/fuel/expenses per vehicle. No additional seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints; reuse it for regression. httpOnly cookie via requests.Session works against the public preview URL. Frontend Add/Edit/Delete vehicle dialog and CRUD dialogs on maintenance/fuel/expenses were not exercised through UI yet—only API parity verified. Next agent can extend Playwright to open the Add Vehicle dialog (data-testid likely 'add-vehicle-button') and confirm new card appears.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Two minor console warnings traced to (a) CrudListPage.jsx wrapping option text in a span and (b) Recharts container without explicit height in Fuel/Expenses cards.
